_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Data Structure profile UML. Aligned to metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifDataStructure/schema.yaml. The schema adds a single distribution-level property (cdi:isStructuredBy) plus a family of $defs for the DataStructure variants and supporting key types. This UML module is correspondingly tight: no composes (cdifCore + cdifDiscovery + cdifDataDescription are composed in BY THE COMPOSITE profile DataDescriptionWithStructure, not here). Anchor stubs (DataDownload, CatalogRecord) provide the attachment points. DataStructureComponent and InstanceVariable are referenced but defined elsewhere (cdifDataType / cdifDataDescription); cross-profile registry handles the linking.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Data Structure Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Data Structure Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Reusable data-structure description: DataStructure variants (Dimensional / Long / Wide), keys, foreign keys, dimension groups
targetModel.definition: CDIF Data Structure profile module - adds cdi:isStructuredBy on a DataDownload, pointing at one of four AbstractDataStructure variants (DataStructure / DimensionalDataStructure / LongDataStructure / WideDataStructure). Each structure has DataStructureComponents and optional PrimaryKey / ForeignKey. The catalog record (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord) MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Data structure description extension classes added by this profile.

package.name: Structures
package.definition: AbstractDataStructure + concrete variants (DataStructure / DimensionalDataStructure / LongDataStructure / WideDataStructure), plus DimensionGroup.

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of classes from cdifCore / cdifDataDescription / cdifDataStructureComponent this profile attaches to or references.

class._comment: DataDownload stub - the host for cdi:isStructuredBy. Full definition in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::DataDownload. The data-structure profile adds the cdi:isStructuredBy property on each schema:distribution DataDownload item.

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - carries the required https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0 conformance declaration.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord. For the data-structure profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0.

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - MUST include the constant https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0 for the data-structure profile.

class._comment: DataStructureComponent stub - the abstract parent of IdentifierComponent / MeasureComponent / AttributeComponent / DimensionComponent / VariableDescriptorComponent / VariableValueComponent. Full subtypes defined in cdifDataType/cdifDataStructureComponent; this stub is here so the diagram can render the cdi:has_DataStructureComponent edges.
class.definition: Stub of cdifDataType::cdifDataStructureComponent (abstract). Subtypes (IdentifierComponent / MeasureComponent / AttributeComponent / DimensionComponent / VariableDescriptorComponent / VariableValueComponent) are defined in that BB.

class._comment: InstanceVariable stub - referenced by PrimaryKey.isComposedOf. Full definition in CDIFDataDescription (and cdifDataType/cdifInstanceVariable).
class.definition: Stub of CDIFDataDescription::InstanceVariable. Referenced by PrimaryKey.isComposedOf - the ordered list of variables that uniquely identify each row.

class._comment: AbstractDataStructure - abstract supertype for the four cdi:isStructuredBy targets. The schema's anyOf on cdi:isStructuredBy is rendered here as the generalization hierarchy underneath.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for the four DataStructure variants. cdi:isStructuredBy on a DataDownload accepts any concrete subtype: DataStructure (general), DimensionalDataStructure (cube), LongDataStructure (variable-value-pair rows), WideDataStructure (wide-format tables).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this structure node; used as the target of @id-reference cdi:isStructuredBy.

class._comment: DataStructure - general data organization based on reusable data structure components. Required: at least one has_DataStructureComponent. Optional has_PrimaryKey and has_ForeignKey.
class.definition: Generic data organization based on reusable data structure components. Carries at least one cdi:has_DataStructureComponent, plus optional cdi:has_PrimaryKey and cdi:has_ForeignKey[].

class._comment: DimensionalDataStructure - cube-shaped structure: dimensions, measures, attributes. Components are constrained to IdentifierComponent / MeasureComponent / AttributeComponent / DimensionComponent.
class.definition: Dimensional data set (multidimensional cube) described by Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension components plus an optional PrimaryKey.

class._comment: LongDataStructure - variable-value-pair (narrow / long) row layout. Exactly one Identifier + one VariableDescriptor + one VariableValue component, plus optional Attribute components.
class.definition: Long (narrow) dataset row layout. Required: exactly one IdentifierComponent, exactly one VariableDescriptorComponent, exactly one VariableValueComponent. AttributeComponents optional.

class._comment: WideDataStructure - wide-format tabular layout. Identifier + Measure + Attribute components.
class.definition: Wide (tabular) dataset layout. Components are the standard cdifDataStructureComponent family; cdi:has_PrimaryKey optional.

class._comment: DimensionGroup - reusable collection of dimensions referenced across multiple dimensional structures.
class.definition: Reusable collection of dimensions that can be shared across multiple dimensional structures. Carries cdi:identifier, cdif:name, cdif:has_DataStructureComponent[].

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the dimension group.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: cdif:name - human-readable name for the dimension group (ISO/IEC 11179-5).

class._comment: PrimaryKey - role of an ordered set of cdi:InstanceVariables uniquely identifying a data instance. Array order of isComposedOf gives the position.
class.definition: Role of an ordered set of cdi:InstanceVariables that uniquely identify each data instance. Position is implicit in the cdif:isComposedOf array order; no ComponentPosition wrapper.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this primary key.

class._comment: PrimaryKeyComponent - role of a data structure component for content identification. Referenced by ForeignKeyComponent.references.
class.definition: Role of a data structure component for content identification. Used in conjunction with PrimaryKey when content-identification is captured at the component level.

class._comment: ForeignKey - role of a set of data structure components for content referencing.
class.definition: Role of a set of data structure components for content referencing (relational foreign-key semantics on a DataStructure).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this foreign key.

class._comment: ForeignKeyComponent - role of a single data structure component for content referencing. References a PrimaryKeyComponent and correspondsTo a DataStructureComponent.
class.definition: Single-component role of a foreign key. Points at the PrimaryKeyComponent it references (cdi:references) and at the DataStructureComponent it corresponds to (cdi:correspondsTo).

association._comment: DataDownload -> CatalogRecord (via the dataset's schema:subjectOf back-ref). Modelled here so the diagram can show where the conformsTo declaration lives.
association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this dataset's metadata. For the data-structure profile, the CatalogRecord MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0.

association._comment: DataDownload -> AbstractDataStructure via cdi:isStructuredBy. Schema's anyOf permits any of the four concrete subtypes plus an @id-reference.
association.definition: cdi:isStructuredBy - the reusable data-structure description for this distribution. One of DataStructure / DimensionalDataStructure / LongDataStructure / WideDataStructure (or @id-reference to one declared elsewhere).

association._comment: AbstractDataStructure -> DataStructureComponent via cdi:has_DataStructureComponent. Inherited by all four subtypes (each subtype constrains the allowed component subtypes differently).
association.definition: cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - the components this structure is composed of. Concrete subtypes constrain the allowed component subtypes (see DimensionalDataStructure / LongDataStructure).

association._comment: AbstractDataStructure -> PrimaryKey via cdi:has_PrimaryKey. Optional on all four subtypes.
association.definition: cdi:has_PrimaryKey - optional primary key on the structure.

association._comment: DataStructure -> ForeignKey via cdi:has_ForeignKey. Only the general DataStructure variant carries foreign keys in the schema.
association.definition: cdi:has_ForeignKey - foreign-key relationships on the general DataStructure variant.

association._comment: DimensionGroup -> DataStructureComponent via cdif:has_DataStructureComponent. DimensionGroups are reusable component collections.
association.definition: cdif:has_DataStructureComponent - the components belonging to this dimension group.

association._comment: PrimaryKey -> InstanceVariable via cdif:isComposedOf. Ordered list of variables that uniquely identify a row.
association.definition: cdif:isComposedOf - ordered list of cdi:InstanceVariables. Array position is the component position.

association._comment: ForeignKey -> ForeignKeyComponent via cdi:isComposedOf. Components of the foreign-key role.
association.definition: cdi:isComposedOf - the components of this foreign key.
cdi:references - the PrimaryKeyComponent on another structure that this foreign-key component points at.
cdi:correspondsTo - the local DataStructureComponent on the host structure that this FK component corresponds to.
cdi:correspondsTo - the local DataStructureComponent this PrimaryKeyComponent corresponds to.
